title: readability: StateChange missing PartialEq derive, test assertions use field equality
description: kith-core/src/events.rs StateChange derives Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize but not PartialEq. Tests in kith-events assert_eq! on individual fields rather than the struct. Adding PartialEq would allow assert_eq!(received, original) which is cleaner and catches future field additions that tests would otherwise miss. There is no architectural reason to omit PartialEq from a plain data struct.
